# Study Material

## Gradient Descent

Gradient descent is an optimization algorithm that minimizes a loss function by iteratively moving in the direction of steepest descent as defined by the negative of the gradient. It is widely used in training machine learning models.

### How it works
1. Initialize model parameters randomly.
2. Compute the gradient of the loss with respect to each parameter.
3. Update each parameter by subtracting the learning rate times the gradient.
4. Repeat until convergence.
